en: The sea gave me back at dawn. Somebody was humming.
There you are. No, don't sit up yet. You've swallowed half the bay.
Lie still, please. Hands open where I can see them. I would rather not.
That's a very big spear for a very small conversation.
Toma. He's half drowned. I think he's allowed one joke.
Then it's a good thing the sea gave you both back.
Good trade. Don't ask what I gave for it.
Then I won't ask. Not today.
Rhen Sallow. Oruvel, the raft-town, east of here, all those ugly hulls tied together. Is it still there?
We watched the storm go east last night. I am sorry.
Come up to the village. Bring your father's light. You'll eat first, and then we'll tell you what we know.
